title.en: An Act Establishing a High School in Barangay Mat-I, Municipality of Naawan, Province of Misamis Oriental, to Be Known as the Mat-I National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a High School in Barangay Mat-I, Municipality of Naawan, Province of Misamis Oriental, to Be Known as the Mat-I National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông tại Barangay Mat-I, Thị trấn Naawan, Tỉnh Misamis Oriental được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Mat-I
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาในบารังไกย์ Mat-I, เทศบาล Naawan, จังหวัด Misamis Oriental ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Mat-I
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas di Barangay Mat-I, Kotamadya Naawan, Provinsi Misamis Oriental dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Mat-I
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah di Barangay Mat-I, Perbandaran Naawan, Wilayah Misamis Oriental dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Mat-I

text.en: There shall be established a national high school in Barangay Mat-i, Municipality of Naawan, Province of Misamis Oriental, to be known as the Mat-i National High School.
The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
